import math, itertools
from collections import defaultdict

def comps(grid, bg):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); res=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if grid[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=grid[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; c=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in c or not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or grid[a][b]!=col: continue
                    c.add((a,b))
                    st+= [(a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)]
                seen|=c; res.append({'color':col,'cells':sorted(c)})
    return res

def feat(o, grid, bg):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); cs=o['cells']
    rs=[p[0] for p in cs]; cl=[p[1] for p in cs]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cl),max(cl)
    h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    shape=tuple(''.join('#' if (i,j) in cs else '.' for j in range(c0,c1+1)) for i in range(r0,r1+1))
    touch=(r0==0, r1==H-1, c0==0, c1==W-1)
    ctr=((r0+r1)/2,(c0+c1)/2)
    corners=[(0,0),(0,W-1),(H-1,0),(H-1,W-1)]
    dcorner=min(math.dist(ctr,k) for k in corners)
    dcenter=math.dist(ctr,(H/2,W/2))
    f={'color':o['color'],'size':len(cs),'h':h,'w':w,'bbox':h*w,'at':(r0,c0),

       'ncells_color':sum(1 for r in grid for x in r if x==o['color'])}
    return f, shape, ctr
